text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Peruvian army frees embassy hostages and kills kidnappers
- One hundred dead in worst killing in Algerian war
- (Prime minister) Aznar denies having given up drive for supression of asylum in EU
EL MUNDO
- President Fujimori frees hostages
- GAL (dirty war) document implicates (former Cesid secret service head) Manglano and reinforces suspicions against (former prime minister) Gonzalez
ABC
- Japan embassy hostages freed in spectacular assault directed by Fujimori with all Tupac Amaru terrorists dead
- By blood and fire: Fujimori exterminates rebels and frees hostages
CINCO DIAS
- Savings banks make eyes at Argentaria
- Wall Street achieves biggest rise since 1991
EXPANSION
- Economy is growing more strongly that official statistics indicate
- Braulio Medel reveals savings banks' interest in future privatisation of Argentaria
- Telefonica alliance fuels contacts between BT-MCI and Japan's NTT
- "Ford Espana will avoid a price war which costs it 12 percent of sales" - interview with chief executive
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Brussels sees deficit of under 3 percent feasible in Spain in 1997
- CCOO and UGT (trade unions) ratify agreement on labour reform
- Iberdrola and Repsol rule out Endesa's entry into alliance
- Government initiates sale of Aldeasa and TISA
